content5.ptxt: This DTC is output when a malfunction occurs in wireless road-to-vehicle communication at a toll gate

item.ptxt: Communication error other than authentication error detected in DSRC communication
Signal from roadside unit can no longer be received normally, and a timeout occurs
Release requested during communication with roadside unit, and communication disconnected
RF module malfunction (PLL lock loss) detected
Malfunction detected during RF module initialization

test1.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), read the DTCs following the screen. (see )
Select "Clear" on the screen display and clear the DTCs following the screen.
Using SST (TaSCAN), check the DTCs again and proceed to the destination below.

testgrp.testtitle: Inspect with ETC On-board Unit Tester

test2.ptxt: Check for any obstructions around the navigation antenna assembly (top surface of the instrument panel), and remove them if present.
Check for any film, stickers, etc. affixed to the windshield glass, and remove them if present.

test1.ptxt: Inspect with ETC On-board Unit Tester

test2.ptxt: Using an ETC on-board unit tester, check whether the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly is performing wireless communication normally.

item.ptxt: Operate the ETC on-board unit tester at a position approximately 1 m from the windshield glass, on a line extending upward and forward of the vehicle from the navigation antenna assembly at an elevation angle of 67±15°. (The distance between the ETC on-board unit tester and the antenna is only a guide)
Point the communication surface of the ETC on-board unit tester toward the navigation antenna assembly.
Do not bring the ETC on-board unit tester too close to the navigation antenna assembly, as communication with the tester may be established even if the antenna is disconnected.

atten3.ptxt: When making an inquiry to the road operator, ask the customer for the toll gate, date and time of the occurrence, etc., obtain the customer's consent to inquire about the travel record with the road operator, and then make the inquiry, explaining that there was a malfunction in the wireless communication.

test1.ptxt: Replace the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly with a new one. (see )

test2.ptxt: Check for any obstructions around the navigation antenna assembly (top surface of the instrument panel), and remove them if present.
Check for any film, stickers, etc. affixed to the windshield glass, and remove them if present.

test1.ptxt: Inspect with ETC On-board Unit Tester

test2.ptxt: Using an ETC on-board unit tester, check that the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly is performing wireless communication normally.

item.ptxt: Operate the ETC on-board unit tester at a position approximately 1m from the windshield glass, on a line extending upward and forward of the vehicle from the navigation antenna assembly at an elevation angle of 67±15°. ((The distance between the ETC on-board unit tester and the antenna is only a guide)
Point the communication surface of the ETC on-board unit tester toward the navigation antenna assembly.
Do not bring the ETC on-board unit tester too close to the navigation antenna assembly, as communication with the tester may be established even if the antenna is disconnected.

test2.ptxt: Insert an ETC card into the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly and check that the card is authenticated normally.

testgrp.testtitle: End (notify the road operator responsible for the toll gate where the problem occurred)
